case.pattern_description: Determined by deterministic signatures and LLM verification.

final.reason: R9: Customer confirmed transaction was unauthorized.

sar.reason: Policy threshold triggered mandatory SAR filing.
sar.narrative: The SAR concerns case HHG-003 involving a customer whose identity status is verified. The trigger for the report is transaction TXN-003 which received a risk score of 0.85. The transaction was flagged despite no explicit flagged transaction details being present. The activity occurred within the banking system at the time the transaction was processed. Analysis revealed a single device relationship linking the customer to a previously closed case HIST-991. The prior case HIST-991 was adjudicated as fraud and involved a card-not-present pattern with a shared device profile. The shared device profile suggests the same device was used in both the current and prior fraudulent activities. Consequently, the high risk score and the connection to a known fraud pattern justify the suspicion of illicit activity.

containment_steps: Place temporary security authorization hold on transaction TXN-003
Issue immediate network-level block on all linked card PANs

customer_communication.message_copy: Did you attempt a purchase of $150.00? Reply YES if this was you, or NO if you did not make this purchase.

financial_remediation: Initiate chargeback procedures for identified exposure

stop_reason: Policy thresholds met or maximum evidence gathered.
